source: Chartularium Sangallense V, Nr. 2842, S. 232-233., FF.4.F.39
Chartularium Sangallense V, Nr. 2842, S. 232-233., 1313 II 02
entries.german:
Abt Heinrich und der Konvent von St. Gallen verleihen Ulrich und Marquard von Ems Einkünfte aus den Höfen Tübach und Marbach und aus dem Gut Moos als Teil des Kaufpreises für Güter zu Steintal und an der Egg.

Allen dien, die disen brief iemer an gesehent alder ho erent lesen, kunden wir von gottes genaden abt Hainrich vnd der conuent alle gemainlich des gotteshuses ze sant Gallen, das wir der vor genemt abt Hainrich mit vnser closter herron aller willen dem er gernden ritter hern V oIrich von A emz vnd sinem brůder Marchwart vnsers gotteshuses dienstmannen reht vnd redlich baiden vnd iro erben, sü sigen man alder vrowen, verlühen haben ze rehtem lehen aht phunt geltes Costenzer munse, als hie nah geschriben stat, zwai phunt geltes vs vnsers gotteshuses hof ze Tufenbach vnd vierdhalb phunt geltes vs vnserm hof ze Marpach vnd drithalb phunt geltes vs dem gůt in dem Mose, vnd mit dien selben aht phunden geltes vnd mit funfen vnd funfz marchen silbers Costenzer geweges do gulten wir vnd widerlaiten dien vor gena emten hern V olrich vnd Marchwart du gu eter vnd die lute, die wir von inen gechofet haben vnd die hie nah geschriben stant, das gůt ze Stainital vnd das gůt an der Egge vnd die lute alle sament, die in du selben gu eter ho erent, ân die lute, die hinder su geuarn waren vber Rin ald in das Rintal vor dem tag, do dirre chof beschach, vnd an Arnolten vnd Růdolfen vs Stainital, die inen ansprechig waren von grauen Kraften von Toggenburg, wir haben vns och gebunden, dien vor genemten hern V olrich vnd Marchwart vnd iro erben fur vns selben vnd fur vnser nah komen wer ze sinn der vor geschriben aht phund geltes nah reht, wir wellen o vch, das alles das, das da vor geschriben ist, ald ie kraft hab, als ob es vor ainem rihter geschehen sige, vnd das die vor genemten hern V olrich vnd Marchwart ald ir erben von vns alder von vnseren nachomenen an dien vor gesprochenen aht phunden geltes niemer mugen bechrenchet werden, dar vmbe so encihen wir vns alles des rehtes, so wir haben von sunder briefen alder von gemainem geschribem reht der ba ebest alder kaiser, da mit wir su nu alder her nah bekrenchen mo ehtin an der selben gult. Vnd das dis war sige vnd stet belibe, dar vmbe so geben wir dien vor genemten hern V olrich vnd Marchwart disen brief besigelt mit vnsere(m) a) insigel ze ainem steten waren vrchunde aller der dinge, so an disem brief da vor geschriben stant. Dis beschach vnd wart an disem brief verschoben ze sant Gallen, in dem jar, do man zalt von gottes geburte druzehenhundert vnd druzehen jar, an vnser vrowen tag ze der liehtmisse, da ze gegen waren die erberen gezuge, die nah geschriben stant, her Růdolf der kilchherre von Roschach, her Johans von Luterberg, Eglolf von Rosenberg, Lütolt der Schenche, Hainrich Walther von Sulzberg, Cůnrat von Luterberg vnd Amôr von Luterberg, V olrich Meldli, Hainrich im Kilchof, Růdolf der schulthaisse von Wile vnd ander biderber luten vil, die es an warhait wissen.
entries.english:
Abbot Heinrich and the convent of St. Gallen grant Ulrich and Marquard von Ems revenues from the farms at Tübach and Marbach and from the property at Moos as part of the purchase price for properties at Steintal and an der Egg.

All those who shall see or hear this letter read in times to come, know that we, abbot Heinrich by the grace of God and the convent generally of the monastery of St. Gallen, have, with the consent of our monastic brothers, rightfully and properly granted and enfeoffed, for themselves and their heirs, whether men or women, the aforesaid reverend knight Herr Ulrich von Ems and his brother Marchwart, ministers of our monastery, as a rightful fief eight pounds of currency in Constance coinage, as is written below: two pounds of revenue from our monastery's farm at Tübach and four and a half pounds of revenue from our farm at Marbach and three and a half pounds of revenue from the property in the Moos. And with the same eight pounds of revenue and with five and a half marks of silver by weight of Constance, we guarantee and defend the aforesaid Herr Ulrich and Marchwart for the properties and the people which we have purchased from them and which are listed below: the property at Steintal and the property at an der Egg and all the people belonging to those properties, excepting the people who had been drawn beyond the Rhine or into the Rintal before the day on which this purchase was made, and excepting Arnolt and Rudolf of Steintal, who were claimed by them from Count Kraft von Toggenburg. We have also bound ourselves, the aforesaid Herr Ulrich and Marchwart and their heirs, to defend against us and our successors for the aforementioned eight pounds of revenue in due form. We further declare that all that is written above, or has any force, should be as if it had been done before a judge, and that the aforesaid Herr Ulrich and Marchwart or their heirs may never be compelled by us or our successors regarding the aforementioned eight pounds of revenue. Therefore we renounce all right which we have from special letters or from common written law of emperor or king, with which we might now or hereafter seek to challenge this same revenue. And that this may be true and stand firm, therefore we give the aforesaid Herr Ulrich and Marchwart this letter sealed with our seal a) as a sure and genuine testimony of all matters set forth in this letter. This was done and dispatched at St. Gallen in the year of our Lord's birth thirteen hundred and thirteen, on our Lady's Day at Candlemas, before whom were present the honorable witnesses listed below: Herr Rudolf, the parish priest of Rorschach; Herr Johans von Luterberg; Egilolf von Rosenberg; Lütolt der Schenche; Heinrich Walther von Sulzberg; Cůnrat von Luterberg and Amôr von Luterberg; Ulrich Meldli; Heinrich im Kilchof; Rudolf the Schultheiss of Wil; and many other trustworthy people, who know this to be true.
